python3 -c "
import random
from sort import sort_list
random.seed(0)
cases = [[], [1], [2,1], [1,1,1], [5,4,3,2,1]]
for _ in range(2000):
    n = random.randint(0, 30)
    cases.append([random.randint(-10**6, 10**6) for _ in range(n)])
for c in cases:
    out = sort_list(c)
    assert out == sorted(c), c
    assert sorted(out) == sorted(c) and len(out) == len(c), c
print('conformance OK:', len(cases), 'cases (edge + 2000 random)')
"
